notes:
Signed native Kotlin/Compose release. Requires Prosit server v0.4.3 for Android passkey sign-in and Frontpage 0.1.7 for correct APK downloads. Installs as the release app, separately from the earlier development preview. Uses native Credential Manager, encrypted vaults, feeds, friends, circles and reviewed sharing; no web wrapper.

Server deployment is required before native passkey sign-in works. The signing certificate was checked against the target server image; live provider sign-in remains pending.
